motorization.title: Shades that move at the touch of a button
motorization.description: The industry is moving toward motorized shades and shutters — and so are we. Every treatment we install can be motorized, two ways:

hardwired.title: Hardwired low voltage
hardwired.description: Wired into your home's low-voltage system — no batteries to charge, ever. The cleanest choice for new builds and renovations.

battery.title: Rechargeable battery + remote
battery.description: No wiring needed — a rechargeable motor fits any existing window, controlled from a handheld remote. Ideal for retrofits.

benefits.title: Easy on your windows, easy on your wallet
benefits.description: Three things every customer gets, no matter the size of the job.

local.title: Your McLean neighbors

delivery.title: Free delivery

commercial.title: One team for homes, offices and everything between
commercial.paragraphOne: Pink Blinds & Shutters caters to both residential as well as commercial customers. Contract pricing is available upon request.
commercial.paragraphTwo: Every product is fabricated with the highest quality materials — and every supplier we work with must meet, and exceed, those standards.
